project_scope.Neuerrichtung einer Intensivstation, spe: New construction of an intensive care unit, specialised in the care of neurological patients, on a floor area of approx. 5,000 m² (including: 20 intensive care rooms, several examination and treatment rooms, a Phase B area, specialised EEG areas and follow-up care for stroke-unit patients).
project_scope.Errichtung eines intraoperativen MRs (Ko: Construction of an intraoperative MRI (a combination of MRI and operating theatre) including all required ancillary rooms.
project_scope.Etablierung eines extrakorporalen Zentru: Establishment of an extracorporeal centre on a floor area of approx. 3,500 m².
project_scope.Austausch der Angiographieanlage innerha: Replacement of the angiography system within the operating theatre area as part of the modernisation of the University Clinic for Neurosurgery.
project_scope.Neuerrichtung eines Planungs-CTs inklusi: New construction of a planning CT including the required surrounding areas (changing room, control room and equipment room). Design and installation of a laser positioning system, a respiratory simulation system and various items of medical equipment.
project_scope.Austausch der Computertomographie im Zug: Replacement of the CT scanner as part of the modernisation of the University Clinic for Neurosurgery.
project_scope.Errichtung von einer Krankenstation für: Construction of a ward for approx. 140 beds in general care across four levels. Level 03: oncology day clinic, Level 04: oncology, Level 05: haematology, Level 06: palliative care and radiation oncology.
project_scope.Austausch von zwei Durchleuchtungsanlage: Replacement of two fluoroscopy systems in separate rooms and adaptation of the rooms to qualify as a "procedure room". Design and installation of medical metal fittings as well as various mobile and fixed medical equipment.
project_scope.Austausch des Altgeräts gegen eine moder: Replacement of the old device with a modern fluoroscopy system. Enlargement of the examination room and adaptation to the current regulatory requirements. Redesign and modernisation of the control room and the equipment room. Design and installation of medical metal fittings as well as various mobile and fixed
project_scope.Errichtung eines medizinischen Versorgun: Construction of a medical care centre with 9 examination and treatment rooms, a laboratory and a dirty utility room.
project_scope.Abbau von vier Sterilisationsanlagen und: Removal of four sterilisation systems and installation of modern devices. Adaptation of the existing medical metal fittings in line with the new requirements.
project_scope.Errichtung einer IMC-Station mit fünf Pa: Construction of an IMC unit with five patient rooms, a nurses' station and various ancillary rooms.
project_scope.Errichtung einer modernen Röntgentherapi: Construction of a modern X-ray therapy system including the required ancillary rooms (equipment room, control room and changing room).
project_scope.Austausch des veralteten Dampfsterilisat: Replacement of the outdated steam steriliser. Renewal of the technical area and the medical metal fittings.
project_scope.Abbau eines Röntgentherapiegeräts und Um: Removal of an X-ray therapy device and repurposing of the room into a preparation room for treatments at the linear accelerator (breathing training). The preparation room includes a surface scanner and a LINAC treatment table.
project_scope.Abbau von zwei Altgeräten und Neueinbrin: Removal of two old devices and installation of a modern washer-disinfector. Division of the project area into a clean and a dirty area. Modernisation of both areas through suitable adaptations to the operational workflow. Design and installation of medical metal fittings as well as various mobile and fixed medical equipment.
project_scope.Umbau von bestehenden Bettenzimmern der: Conversion of existing urology bed rooms into two private-class rooms, including the construction of a modern dirty utility room.
Conversion of existing orthopaedics bed rooms into three private-class rooms, including the construction of a modern dirty utility room.
project_scope.Neuerrichtung von 39 Kühlzellen im Rahme: New construction of 39 cold-storage cells as part of the redesign of the entire floor plan, coordinated with the operational workflow. Expansion of the autopsy dissection tables as well as design and installation of medical metal fittings.
project_scope.Zwei Operationssäle, Intensivstation (IC: Two operating theatres, an intensive care unit (ICU) and an intermediate care unit (IMCU), as well as a fully equipped radiology department
project_scope.Austausch des Linearbeschleunigers inklu: Replacement of the linear accelerator including the patient positioning system. Modernisation of the control and equipment rooms of the linear accelerator.
project_scope.Austausch der alten Angiographieanlage z: Replacement of the old angiography system with a biplane system, as well as replacement of the CT scanner with a CT system featuring a sliding gantry. Design and installation of medical metal fittings as well as various mobile and fixed medical equipment.
project_scope.Errichtung eines Hybrid-OPs. Planung und: Construction of a hybrid operating theatre. Design and installation of medical metal fittings as well as various mobile and fixed medical equipment (including: heart-lung machine, ventilators, anaesthesia machine, suction systems).
project_scope.Modernisierung und Adaptierung von drei: Modernisation and adaptation of three operating theatres for the use of surgical robots. Design and installation of medical metal fittings as well as various mobile and fixed medical equipment.
project_scope.Austausch des Linearbeschleunigers inklu: Replacement of the linear accelerator including the patient positioning system. Modernisation of the control and equipment room of the linear accelerator and adaptation to suit the new system.
project_scope.Planung und Errichtung einer Intensivsta: Design and construction of an intensive care unit for eight beds, a POC laboratory, an equipment store, a dirty utility room and further ancillary rooms. Special feature: establishment of the intensive care unit on the former areas of office rooms.
project_scope.Errichtung eines Endoskopie-OPs. Planung: Construction of an endoscopy operating theatre. Design and installation of medical metal fittings as well as various mobile and fixed medical equipment.
project_scope.Austausch der alten MR-Anlage sowie Mode: Replacement of the old MRI system and modernisation of the preparation room. Modernisation of the control and equipment room. Adaptation of the preparation room for the care of emergency patients. Design and installation of medical metal fittings as well as various mobile and fixed medical equipment
project_scope.Errichtung einer PET-CT-Anlage und eines: Construction of a PET-CT system and an additional workstation for the preparation of radionuclides.
Replacement of the old angiography system. Adaptation and modernisation of the control room and the equipment room.
project_scope.Planung und Errichtung einer Intensivsta: Design and construction of an intensive care unit for eight beds, a POC laboratory, an equipment store, a dirty utility room and further ancillary rooms.
Replacement of the existing PET-CT system. Adaptation of the existing examination room, the workstations in the control room and the equipment room.
project_scope.Austausch von zwei Matratzendesinfektion: Replacement of two mattress disinfection systems including adaptation of the medical metal fittings.
project_scope.Modernisierung und Adaptierung der physi: Modernisation and adaptation of the physical therapy department over an area of approx. 1,380 m², including the pain clinic.
project_scope.Austausch der bestehenden Röntgenanlage: Replacement of the existing X-ray system with a new digital system. Design and installation of medical metal fittings as well as various mobile and fixed medical equipment.
project_scope.Modernisierung des Bestandsgebäudes auf: Modernisation of the existing building across six levels. Construction of an extension and the addition of one storey. Design and installation of various mobile and fixed medical equipment (ECG devices, EEG, patient beds, examination couches, defibrillators, etc.).
project_scope.Austausch des Durchleuchtungsgeräts, Abw: Replacement of the fluoroscopy device, handling of all regulatory activities relating to laser applications and modernisation of the rest room.
project_scope.Austausch der Bestandsanlage auf ein neu: Replacement of the existing system with a new digital system.
project_scope.Umbau einer Bürofläche für die Errichtun: Conversion of an office area for the construction of a bed disinfection system.
project_scope.Errichtung eines Ambulanzbereichs (unter: Construction of an outpatient area (including: transplant centre, examination and treatment rooms as well as areas for cardiac technology) for cardiothoracic surgery patients over an area of approx. 1,900 m².
project_scope.Errichtung eines Aufwachraums mit drei B: Construction of a recovery room with three bed positions for the five operating theatres of neurosurgery, as well as a monitoring station for nursing staff and a dirty utility room.
project_scope.Modernisierung und Neustrukturierung der: Modernisation and restructuring of the outpatient areas of cardiology and angiology (15 rooms).
project_scope.Umfunktionierung von einem Laborbereich: Repurposing of a laboratory area into three examination and treatment rooms.
project_scope.Adaptierung der Aufbereitungsanlagen und: Adaptation of the reprocessing systems and conversion of the medical metal fittings so that the surgical instruments of the surgical robots can be cleaned. Conversion of reprocessing systems for two operating theatres and the central sterilisation department.
project_scope.Das Krankenhaus verfügt über 58 Betten,: The hospital has 58 beds, 12 observation beds, two operating theatres as well as a hybrid operating theatre and a cardiac catheterisation laboratory, and treats approximately 2,200 inpatients and approximately 6,200 outpatients each year.
project_scope.Über rund zweieinhalb Jahre vor Ort in K: Over roughly two and a half years on site in crisis and conflict regions in Syria, Jordan and Lebanon: the needs-based equipping of medical facilities under the most challenging conditions – with needs assessments, equipment evaluations, procurement, logistics and the quality assurance of local suppliers.
